episodes.task: Repair merge_intervals in src/intervals.py. Consume the interval iterable once, validate that each item is a two-element tuple/list of finite real numbers with start <= end (booleans are invalid), sort without mutating input objects, and return lists merging both overlapping and touching intervals. Return [] for empty input. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement overlay in src/config.py using the exact converters in src/schema.py. Return a new dict and never mutate defaults or env. Only recognized schema keys with the prefix PGR_ may override defaults, using upper-case schema names. Ignore unrelated environment entries. If a recognized value fails conversion, propagate ValueError. Preserve APIs, run visible tests, then finish.

Fix simulate_lru in src/lru.py. capacity must be a positive non-boolean integer. Consume accesses once. A hit moves the key to most-recent position. A miss inserts it and evicts exactly the least-recent key when full. Return dict hits, misses, evictions (in order), and final keys from least to most recent. Keys must be hashable; propagate TypeError. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement parse_lines in src/kv.py. Consume lines once. Ignore blank lines and lines whose first non-space character is #. Every other line must contain exactly one '=' separator with a nonempty trimmed ASCII identifier key and a nonempty trimmed value. Reject duplicate keys and malformed/non-string lines with ValueError. Preserve insertion order in the returned dict. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement flatten in src/tree.py. Input must be a dict whose keys at every level are nonempty strings without '/'. Nested dicts are branches; every non-dict is a leaf. Return a new dict mapping slash-joined paths to the original leaf objects, traversed in insertion order. Reject empty branch dicts and a non-dict root with ValueError. Do not mutate the tree. Run visible tests, then finish.

Refactor allocate in src/allocation.py. workers must be a nonempty sequence of unique nonempty strings. Consume items once and assign them cyclically in worker order. Return a dict containing every worker in input order, including empty lists, and preserve item identity/order. Reject invalid workers with ValueError and never mutate either input. Run visible tests, then finish.
